dialog.anonymous: {{item}}. They won’t see who reported it.
dialog.pickOne: Pick the reason that fits best.
dialog.detailsHint: Tell us anything that helps us check. At most {{max}} characters.
dialog.detailsTooLong: That’s too long. Keep it under 2,000 characters.
dialog.aPersonReads: A person on our team reads every report. Nothing changes until we’ve checked it.
dialog.signedOut: Log in to report this. If you don’t have an account, the public report form is coming soon.

sent.heading: Report sent
sent.body: Thanks. A person on our team will read it and tell you what we decide.

failures.refused: We couldn’t take this report. You can’t report your own things, and the item may no longer exist.
failures.too_many: You’ve sent a lot of reports in the last hour. Please try again later.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
failures.paused: Your reporting is paused for now. You can still read and write.

illegal_content.label: Illegal content
illegal_content.hint: Breaks the law in another way.

harassment.label: Harassment
harassment.hint: Bullying, threats or targeting a person.

self_harm.label: Self-harm
self_harm.hint: Encourages or shows self-harm or suicide.

child_sexual_content.label: Sexual content involving a minor
child_sexual_content.hint: Any sexual content involving someone under 18. We act on this first.

threat_to_minor.label: Threat to a minor
threat_to_minor.hint: Grooming, threats or pressure aimed at someone under 18. We act on this first.

hate.label: Hate
hate.hint: Attacks people for who they are.

spam.label: Spam
spam.hint: Ads, scams or the same post over and over.

copyright.label: Copyright
copyright.hint: Uses your own work, or someone else’s, without permission.

copied_published_work.label: Copied from a published work
copied_published_work.hint: Text taken from a book or article that is already published.

undisclosed_ai.label: Missing AI label
undisclosed_ai.hint: Written with AI but not labelled as AI-assisted.

copied.legend: Where was it copied from? (all optional)
copied.titleHelps: Even just the title of the published work helps us check.
copied.title: Title of the published work (optional)
copied.author: Author (optional)
copied.passage: The matching passage in the published work (optional)
copied.passageHint: Paste the lines the story copies, so a moderator can compare them.

questions.heading: Questions about your reports
questions.intro: The moderation team needs a little more to check what you reported. Your answer goes only to them.
questions.thanks: Thank you. The moderation team has your answer.
questions.loadFailed: We couldn’t load the questions about your reports. Try again later.
questions.answerFailed: We couldn’t send your answer. Check your connection and try again.
